body.x: KAB Ventures (CEO Park Jeong-min), an in-house venture company of Korea Appraisal Board, will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its Korean-style real smart city platform WINDOW VIEW for the first time in the world.
KAB Ventures' Korean-style real smart city platform, WINDOW VIEW, uses 360 ° VR image-based technology with e-FORM technology, a powerful electronic document solution.

The WINDOW VIEW platform is a service that embodies the smart city of the future society, and builds the external and internal platform of the city based on 360 ° VR image for the real city of Korea and strengthens information security. In conjunction with the document solution, it can ① make real estate transaction electronic contract ② reserve hospital appointments and submit documents ③ close car rental contract ④ apply for high school counseling without having to visit on-site. This is an innovative smart city with improved productivity and efficiency.

CEO Park said, "Like how we build the Internet by satellite Internet network and care for children in developing countries with 100 dollar laptop projects in the US, I think that the direction of advanced ICT technology should be human.” He continued, “The WINDOW VIEW platform by KAB Ventures should also be powerful, easy, and low cost, and we are planning to help small-sized local governments or developing countries first to maximize value.”

CEO Park made an announcement on the best example of public company's venture management activities at ComeUp 2019, the largest global startup event in Korea hosted by MSS and the global program KOREA OPEN INNOVATION Forum on November 29 and received attention from the proptech industry.
